title: Looks Cheap
text: Looks Cheap. My husband was convinced this was just what we needed to spruce up the dull kitchen. He was wrong, as men usually are. It looks awful. It just looks super cheap, like something you'd pick up at the Dollar Store. The edges are stitched very widely, so it kind of highlights the edging. The rug has a cheap polyester feel to it, as well. It is also very thin. That might be a bonus if you want it in front of a door. But for my uses, it was not a benefit.
